description: This file defines a React functional component 'NotesPanel' which manages and displays a list of notes, along with create/edit/delete functionality, handling various UI states (loading, error, create, edit, view). It depends on external services for data operations and a child component 'NoteEditor'.

methods.name: NotesPanel
methods.description: React component managing notes list, enabling create, edit, delete, and display functionalities based on various UI states.

methods.name: startCreate
methods.description: Initiates creation mode for a new note, deselecting any current selection.

methods.name: startEdit
methods.description: Enables editing mode for the selected note.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Handles creation of a new note by calling external create function.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Handles saving updates to the selected note by calling external update function.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of the selected note via external remove function.
